en-GB.title: DoseWise
en-GB.subtitle: Medicine reminders & checks
en-GB.description:
DoseWise reminds you to take your medicines on time, using your phone's own alarms, so reminders work even without internet.

SIMPLE FOR EVERYONE
• Easy View: larger text and buttons, fewer screens, and confirmations read aloud
• Log a dose straight from the reminder: Taken, Snooze or Skip
• Medicines due at the same time share one reminder, so you aren't flooded with alerts
• Mark a medicine as critical and DoseWise rings like an alarm if it's 30 minutes late

CHECK YOU HAVE THE RIGHT MEDICINE
• Scan the box to fill in the name and strength
• Before a dose, take a photo of the box or pill: DoseWise checks the strength against your prescription and warns you if it's different
• Photos are checked on your phone and deleted straight after

FAMILY UPDATES (OPTIONAL)
• Choose up to 5 family members to get a WhatsApp message if a dose isn't confirmed, a daily summary, or both
• They see the time, not your medicine names, unless you choose otherwise
• You can stop sharing at any time; they can reply STOP

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your medicines, history and photos stay on your phone, in encrypted storage
• No account needed unless you turn on family updates
• Family updates are stored in South Africa and follow POPIA
• No ads, no tracking

DoseWise helps you remember and record your medicines. It does not give medical advice and doesn't replace your doctor or pharmacist.

review.notes: DoseWise works fully without an account: add a medicine (or tap 'Scan the box'), then use Taken/Snooze/Skip on the reminder. Photo checks run on the device. Only the optional 'Family updates' feature (Settings > Family updates) needs sign-in, by SMS code to a phone number; a demo video of that flow is attached. Time Sensitive notifications are used only for the 10- and 30-minute follow-ups when a dose is not logged. The app does not provide dosing advice: the photo check only compares the strength printed on the box with the strength the user entered.
